# Xu "Joe" Dong (Joe Dong · 董旭)

> Xu "Joe" Dong — also written Joe Dong, Xu Joe Dong, Joe Xu Dong, Dong Xu, X. Dong, or 董旭 — is the Founder & CTO of Chestnut Robotics (previously TetherIA; Chinese name 绳肌妙算), building the data engine and dexterous hardware behind physical AI. He believes general models will win robotics — and that building them is a systems problem. He is a physicist by training and a computer-vision researcher by trade, and writes the newsletter "Physical AI Deep Dives". Canonical homepage: https://joedong.ai/

## Identity

- Canonical name: Xu Dong; goes by Joe Dong; Chinese name 董旭; publishes academically as X. Dong.
- All of these refer to the same person: Xu Dong · Joe Dong · Xu "Joe" Dong · Xu Joe Dong · Joe Xu Dong · Dong Xu · X. Dong · 董旭.
- Role: Founder & CTO, Chestnut Robotics (Santa Clara / Mountain View, USA). The company was previously named TetherIA; its GitHub organization still uses that name.

## Background (drawn to scale: 2010 → present)

- 2010–2014 — BS in Physics, University of Science and Technology of China (USTC · 中国科学技术大学).
- 2014–2019 — PhD moving into computer vision, working on medical image analysis (Virginia Tech): sparse-view CT reconstruction, X-ray fluorescence molecular imaging, lesion segmentation.
- 2019–2025 — Autonomous driving, through three of the field's paradigm shifts: monocular 3D detection (2019–21), learning-based planning (2021–23), end-to-end foundation models (2023–25). Tech lead for the planning model behind XPeng's production end-to-end driving; earlier, planning foundation models ("motion planning as token prediction") at Waymo.
- 2025– — Cofounded Chestnut Robotics: physical AI / embodied intelligence, dexterous manipulation, and the data engine behind it (egocentric, high-fidelity capture that turns human demonstrations into robot skill).

## Building (Chestnut Robotics)

- Aero Hand — 18-DOF dexterous robotic hand, sub-millimeter precision.
- Aero UMI — data-collection (capture) exoskeleton.
- GAIN3D — 3D reconstruction component of the data engine.
- aero-hand-open — open-source, 3D-printed, tendon-driven robot hand; complete kit ≈ $314: https://github.com/TetherIA/aero-hand-open
- Company: https://chestnut.bot/

## Selected publications (as X. Dong)

- Radar-Camera Fusion via Representation Learning in Autonomous Driving — CVPR-W 2021 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.07825 (first author)
- Probabilistic Oriented Object Detection in Automotive Radar — CVPR-W 2020 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.05310 (first author)
- A Sparse-View CT Reconstruction Method Based on Combination of DenseNet and Deconvolution — IEEE TMI 2018 — https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2018.2823338 (co-author)
- Full list: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Aud0J0YAAAAJ

## Writing

- Newsletter: "Physical AI Deep Dives" — https://newsletter.joedong.ai/ — deep dives on robotics and physical AI papers, system design, and commercial implications. Signature idea: "The most useful split in robot learning isn't VLA vs. world model — it's system thinking vs. model thinking."
